loanServicing.name: Document Review
items: Review loan documents for servicing requirements, payment terms, funding conditions, reserves and reporting obligations
Coordinate with the EB-5 fund’s loan counsel to identify inconsistencies and clarify administration procedures before closing

loanServicing.name: Loan Closing and Setup
items: Review executed documents and establish loan records, payment schedules and covenant tracking
Verify opening balances, set up reserve and escrow accounts, and communicate servicing procedures to the borrower

loanServicing.name: Funding and Disbursement
items: Review funding requests and supporting documentation against loan requirements
For construction loans, coordinate inspections, review lien waivers, and monitor budget availability and cost to complete before recommending disbursements

loanServicing.name: Servicing and Monitoring
items: Calculate and collect payments, administer reserves, and track taxes and insurance
Review borrower reporting and covenant compliance, provide lender updates, and escalate delinquencies or material exceptions

loanServicing.name: Repayment and Closeout
items: Track maturity dates and coordinate repayment requirements
Prepare payoff statements, reconcile principal, interest and fees, and coordinate collateral releases and the return of remaining reserves following receipt of cleared funds
